entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner has approached this Court seeking a direction to the 3rd respondent to consider Ext.P7, which is a petition styled as an objection to Ext.P6 award.

According to the petitioner, the competent authority has failed to consider the matter in a proper manner and therefore, a lower amount of compensation has been fixed in respect of the land acquired from the petitioner.

2. The learned Government Pleader appearing for the competent authority and the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the National Highways Authority of India would point out that after an award has been passed, the only remedy open to the petitioner is to file an application under Section 3G(5)
of the National Highways Act, 1956 before the District Collector, who is the nominated Arbitrator to consider a challenge to Ext.P6 award.
The District Collector exercises no other jurisdiction over Ext.P6 award.

Accordingly, this writ petition will stand disposed of directing that Ext.P7 shall be treated as an application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 and the 3 rd WP(C) NO. 18707 OF 2023 respondent shall endeavour to dispose of Ext.P7 as expeditiously as possible.
It is made clear that if the petitioner wishes to file any additional documents or pleadings, it will be open to the petitioner to do so before the 3 rd respondent.
The 3rd respondent shall decide the matter in accordance with law and after affording an opportunity to all concerned, including the NHAI.

Sd/-
